sentences.text: The current UCB directions say a Tier 3 UCB shall not levy pre-payment charges on loans with sanctioned amount or limit up to ₹50 lakh, and they also say no pre-payment charges that were not disclosed as specified shall be charged by a UCB.

The cited directions do not state any monetary penalty amount for a UCB that levies prohibited foreclosure charges, and the superseded 2014 and 2025 pre-payment-charge directions listed in the record were withdrawn or repealed.

missing.searched: searched the in-force UCB Responsible Business Conduct Directions, 2025 and the withdrawn/repealed pre-payment-charge directions for any RBI monetary penalty for levying prohibited foreclosure charges.
